items.title: Sound perception and word recognition
items.expectation: Resolve most sound, stress, and reduction variation in standard familiar and field-related input.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Consonant contrasts and place or manner clarity
items.expectation: Sustain consonant clarity throughout extended speech so accent has little effect on understanding.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Vowel contrasts and reduced vowels
items.expectation: Use stable stressed vowels and functional reductions so pronunciation remains intelligible throughout.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Syllable shape, consonant clusters, and word endings
items.expectation: Preserve syllable structure reliably at natural speed, including less familiar and field-related words.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Audible grammatical endings
items.expectation: Integrate endings naturally into clusters and connected speech without loss of grammatical information.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Word stress and stress-sensitive recognition
items.expectation: Control stress reliably in broad general and field-related vocabulary, including many derived words.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Sentence prominence and rhythm
items.expectation: Use prominence and rhythm consistently to support focus, contrast, turn structure, and intelligibility.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Connected-speech perception and production
items.expectation: Handle common connected-speech processes at a natural pace with intelligibility throughout.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Intonation, interaction, and stance
items.expectation: Control intonation consistently enough to support viewpoint, stance, turn management, and social meaning.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

items.title: Chunking, pausing, monitoring, and pronunciation repair
items.expectation: Manage pausing and repair smoothly enough to sustain extended independent interaction.
items.exit_boundary: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.
